picks.title: The Missing Diplomat
picks.why: 17 steps over levels 28–38 across both continents; a political mystery from Stormwind to Theramore.

picks.title: On Guard in Stonetalon
picks.why: 16 steps through 7 maps on both continents, ending with an audience with Tyrande.

picks.title: Welcome to the Jungle
picks.why: 19 steps of Nesingwary's safari, with King Bangalash and other elites, and the Green Hills of Stranglethorn.

picks.title: Claws from the Deep
picks.why: 15 steps from the Wetlands coast to Stormwind, following the shamed lieutenant.

picks.title: The Howling Vale
picks.why: Ashenvale, the Barrens, Booty Bay and Duskwood, ending with the Scythe of Elune.

picks.title: The Unsent Letter
picks.why: 12 steps of the Stormwind conspiracy, ending with an audience with the king.

picks.title: Deliveries to Sven
picks.why: 16 steps of Sven's revenge in Duskwood, ending with Morbent Fel.

picks.title: The Hermit
picks.why: 15 steps of Abercrombie's work in Duskwood, ending with the Bride of the Embalmer.

picks.title: The Legend of Stalvan
picks.why: 13 steps through Elwynn, Westfall, Duskwood and Stormwind, uncovering Stalvan's past.

picks.title: The Defias Brotherhood
picks.why: Westfall's story, ending at VanCleef in the Deadmines.

picks.title: Dragonkin Menace
picks.why: The Alliance Onyxia attunement: 18 steps over levels 54–60, 5 elites, a boss and 4 dungeon steps.

The Dark Iron camp at Dun Modr: three short chains and standalone quests at an elite camp, one of them a Stockade prerequisite, that together tell the fall of Dun Modr and the attack on the Thandol Span.
